verdict.rationale: The docs show only Cloud Backup to a Microsoft personal account (or iCloud on iOS), so accounts can be restored if you lose your phone or get a new device. That is one-time backup and restore, not tokens living on several devices at once and syncing automatically. Notification mirroring to a wearable is not token sync. Missing for 10: simultaneous multi-device token availability, automatic continuous sync, a tablet or desktop/computer client, independent corroboration.
